annotations.title: Trades on all DEXes, large trades

description: Settled swaps on every Cardano DEX, newest first, optionally only those of at least `minAda` ADA ("large trades", "whale trades") or on one DEX. `window` is how far back to look (default 24 hours). Each trade has the time, DEX, the token traded (see `tokenUnits` for units), amounts, price and value in ADA and USD, the trader's stake address, the app that built the order and the transaction hash. For the trades of one token, pool or wallet use `get_recent_trades`.

cursor.description: Value of `nextCursor` from the previous call, to get the next page.

dex.description: Only this DEX, by its name as `list_dexes` returns it.

limit.description: How many trades to return (1-50, default 10).

minAda.description: Only trades worth at least this many ADA (for example 10000).
